name: readiness_missing_signals_reweight
why: Partial logging must still produce a score by proportional reweighting, never by treating missing as zero.

given.formula_note: present weights sleep .25, energy .15 renormalize to .625/.375; sleep=75, energy=25; all other signals absent (weights redistributed). score=round(.625*75+.375*25)=round(56.25)

must_include.reason: UI notes which signals are unlogged and that logging them improves the score
